agents.name: QueryAgent
agents.description: Retrieves data based on natural-language queries and passes results to downstream tools or agents.

agents.name: ExtractAgent
agents.description: Extracts structured data from unstructured input such as documents, web pages, or emails.

agents.name: WorkflowAgent
agents.description: Coordinates multiple agents in a defined sequence, optionally including conditional branches and fallbacks.

agents.name: SummarizeAgent
agents.description: Summarizes content for human readability or to pass into other systems (e.g., captioning, preview generation).

agents.name: NotifyAgent
agents.description: Sends messages, alerts, or status updates based on trigger rules.
